response.sql: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_spend FROM budget_totals) SELECT AVG(bt.total_cost) AS average_total, SUM(bt.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(bt.total_cost - bm.average_spend) AS average_excess FROM budget_totals AS bt CROSS JOIN benchmark AS bm WHERE bt.total_cost > bm.average_spend;
